caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular box with blue edges and corners, featuring decorative panels on its visible sides. The front panel shows two human figures on either side of a brown animal with long legs and a short tail, possibly a stag or similar quadruped; both figures are dressed in red garments and black hats, and one holds a long object resembling a horn, while the other holds a yellow staff or spear. Additional motifs on this panel include red and white garlands or semicircular decorations, a yellow curving branch, a heart shape containing a face, and a star. The side panel displays a green-bordered circle enclosing a bird standing on or beside a large wheel or arch, next to a red goblet-shaped object on a pedestal. The box lid has a blue border and features a central rectangular design with red loops. The overall background of the box is a weathered beige or tan color. The artist's name "John Koehl" appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Bridal Chest
